column1: # The question this repository exists to answer: does STP decide these queries
# faster than Bitwuzla?
# label <TAB> backend <TAB> LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libstp (or -) <TAB> extra klee args
# stp-tuned is the configuration measured best on fp-bench: MiniSat, the
# adaptive incremental policy, and the query bounded in-process rather than by
# forking a process per query. It needs an STP built against a MiniSat carrying
# the terminator hook, or --max-solver-time is only enforced between calls into
# the SAT solver.
stp-tuned
stp-shipped
bitwuzla
z3
# Two settings here were established by this suite rather than inherited.
# --stp-cnf-auto-threshold=0 makes STP's auto CNF effort pick very-low
# everywhere. Worth 19% of solver time on this corpus; see "Where STP's auto
# CNF threshold belongs for KLEE" in RESULTS.md. It needs an STP carrying
# stp/stp#998, which is in master.
# --bitwuzla-rewrite-level=1 is cheap term rewriting without the full pass.
# Worth 10% per driver and 18% of the whole bill, with no tail; both the
# default (2) and none (0) are worse. See "What to actually pass Bitwuzla".
# Bitwuzla's session (--bitwuzla-incremental) is deliberately NOT here: it is
# faster per driver and worse in total, on a tail of 9 drivers past 2x.
